wiki.content: “Hoe Phase” is an upbeat, club-oriented song, offering a colorful and energetic contrast to HABIBTI. The song serves as a lighthearted anthem dedicated to enjoying single life and party culture without any emotional attachment or judgment. "It’s like that, that" The song samples the stuttering vocal loop from the iconic Run-D.M.C. track “It’s Like That.” The musical production leans heavily into high-energy dance music, notably making an interpolation of “Cha Cha Slide.” This choice creates a nostalgic, fast-paced rhythm that shifts the focus away from intense rap commentary and moves it directly toward the dance vibe Drake was aiming for in this project.
